app: SQLAM Dunk (Next.js static-export SQL learning game)
summary: 8 of 9 browser checks passed. One genuine bug found: guest progress is never restored from localStorage after a page reload, even though it IS written there (case-workspace.tsx mount effect unconditionally resets in-memory state and only restores from Supabase for logged-in users; there is no window.localStorage.getItem call anywhere in the file).

checks.criterion: Guest progress persists in localStorage across reload
checks.name: workspace-persistence-bug-evidence
checks.evidence: After solving Q1, localStorage key 'sqlam-dunk-case-001-progress' correctly contains {"solved":[0],...}. After page.reload() + re-entering the case, the SAME localStorage value is still present unmodified, but solved-count-display shows '0/21' and challenge-nav-item-2 is locked again -- the UI never re-reads it. Root cause: components/case-workspace.tsx mount useEffect (around line 79-103) unconditionally calls setSolved([]); setJournal([]); setCareer(emptyCareer) and only repopulates them from Supabase user_metadata when a logged-in user exists; there is no `localStorage.getItem(progressKey)` call anywhere in the file to restore guest progress, despite SPEC.md stating 'Guest progress is stored locally' and persistLocalProgress() writing it correctly.

bugs.criterion: Hints, expected output, read-only guard, persistence
bugs.description: Guest (not-logged-in) progress is written to localStorage correctly but is NEVER read back from it, so a page reload silently resets all solved challenges, unlocked games, and journal entries to zero in the UI even though the underlying data survives in localStorage. This breaks the core 'progress in localStorage' guest-mode promise from SPEC.md and the acceptance criterion.
bugs.location: components/case-workspace.tsx, mount useEffect (~lines 79-103): unconditional setSolved([]); setJournal([]); setCareer(emptyCareer); no localStorage.getItem(progressKey) anywhere in file.

action_items: Fix components/case-workspace.tsx mount effect to read and restore `sqlam-dunk-case-001-progress` and `sqlam-dunk-career` from localStorage for guest (non-authenticated) users before/instead of resetting state to empty, mirroring the existing Supabase-restore branch for logged-in users.
